## History

Fred Wright became secretly engaged to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). Their engagement became known to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during the busy preparations for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding, prompting a heartfelt conversation between the two close friends regarding love and their respective futures.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P41](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0041), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), +104 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright is romantically involved with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and the two become secretly engaged during the preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding. Their romantic relationship marks a significant step toward their future together, which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later confides to her close friend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Although they move in the same local social circles in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), their dynamic centers on this private commitment to marry.

- Romantically involved with — engaged / courting  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)</sub>
- Spouse of — fiancé / engaged to marry  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P18](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0018)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are peers in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who work together on local community initiatives. Both participate in the village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), attending meetings to address neighborhood issues such as unwanted fence advertisements and controversial painting projects. Their relationship is characterized by shared civic involvement alongside the rest of their local social circle.

- Comrade of — canvassing partners  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048)</sub>
